rules.text: Keep the feeling of a real American reader's everyday outfit. Let the bookish identity create a natural reason to wear it; show the garment clearly, without explaining the printed joke.
Keep the wearer visually youthful and casually alternative, with believable house-party or everyday energy. Avoid staged gothic cosplay or exaggerated reactions; let the actual print set the tone.
Make geek humor feel like ordinary American workplace or friend-group self-expression. Favor believable coworker timing and natural understated reactions; keep the actual graphic visible.

For sweater-category references, preserve the silhouette, hem construction and visible short surface texture actually present in THIS original image; do not impose generic ribbing or invent fiber content.
For tee-category references, preserve the actual T-shirt cut and original fabric drape. Do not tighten the torso or change the neckline merely to emphasize the changing print.

Keep the garment silhouette, neckline, hem, visible fabric surface and natural drape consistent with THIS original product image. Never invent fiber composition, print lettering or unseen construction.
